Logstash is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2019.

What it was for: [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1) and [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [server-ansible](@/work/server-ansible.md): Server Ansible; [Test-Elixir](@/work/test-elixir.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Logstash: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Logstash to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
